name: stamp-system
description: Secure Tracking & Anonymous Meeting Protocol - Court-mandated attendance verification system

scripts.setup:dev: npm install && npm run setup:db && npm run setup:keys
scripts.setup:db: docker-compose up -d postgres redis && sleep 10 && npm run db:migrate
scripts.build:all: npm run build --workspace=backend && npm run build --workspace=validator-portal
scripts.test:all: npm run test --workspace=backend && npm run test --workspace=validator-portal && npm run test --workspace=mobile
scripts.lint:all: npm run lint --workspace=backend && npm run lint --workspace=validator-portal && npm run lint --workspace=mobile
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run build:all && npm run docker:build && ./scripts/deploy-staging.sh
scripts.deploy:prod: npm run security:audit && npm run test:all && ./scripts/deploy-production.sh
